name: phase_01_step_up_idempotency
lock_risk: Creates one initially empty Identity replay table, two indexes, one scope-registry row, and bounded API-role privileges without rewriting existing identity data.
representative_data: Runs against empty, version-two, version-six, and deterministic three-principal Phase 01 migration lanes with concurrent scoped-key claims.
query_plan_review: The unique scoped-key index provides single-row claim and replay lookup; partial processing-expiry and retention indexes bound lease recovery and later cleanup.
space_risk: Adds one bounded replay record per accepted step-up idempotency key, retaining only hashes, protocol response metadata, and references to short-lived OIDC state.
forward_fix: Correct released replay lifecycle, constraint, or privilege behavior with a new ordered migration while preserving completed response facts and consumed OIDC state.
rollback: Disable step-up initiation before a forward fix; do not erase completed replay records, revive consumed OIDC state, or relax tenant and workforce scope constraints.
